description: Search PORTUGUESE public-procurement AWARDED CONTRACTS published through Portal BASE (base.gov.pt), run by IMPIC. Filter by free-text keyword (matched against the Portuguese contract title), buyer (adjudicante/contracting-authority) name substring, supplier (adjudicatário/awarded contractor) name substring, contract-amount range (EUR), and a publish-date range. Returns compact shaped contracts: contract id, title, buyer, supplier, amount (EUR), contract type(s), CPV, publish date, and the contract-signing date. Call pt_contract_detail with the returned idcontrato for the full record.

buyer.description: Contracting-authority (buyer/adjudicante) name, partial match, Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal do Porto", "Ministério".

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest date in the loaded window (see contract_window_to in any response).

limit.description: Max contracts to return (default 20, max 100). Newest-first.

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive, matched against the Portuguese contract title, e.g. "pavimentação", "formação", "software".

supplier.description: Awarded supplier (adjudicatário) name, partial match, e.g. "Mota-Engil", "Altice".

name: pt_contract_search
title: Pt Contract Search
